breaking_news.headline: Should you sign your kids up for Trump Accounts? Four things to consider
breaking_news.summary: Families can still benefit even if their children aren't eligible for the free $1,000 contribution from the federal government.

breaking_news.headline: New aviation mechanics graduate with jobs in hand, thanks to a labor shortage
breaking_news.summary: Aviation is literally soaring in the U.S., with record passenger numbers. But with a generation of mechanics set to leave the workforce, the industry needs new graduates to fill the gap.

breaking_news.headline: EPA proposes weakening heavy-duty truck pollution rules
breaking_news.summary: The Trump EPA calls Biden-era rules for cutting pollution from heavy trucks "unworkable." The proposed changes have been celebrated by trucking groups and denounced by environmental groups.

breaking_news.headline: Gas prices are swinging. How to budget for volatility
breaking_news.summary: Gas prices have fluctuated since the U.S. and Israel launched a war on Iran, which disrupted shipping through the Strait of Hormuz and left consumers unsure of what they'll pay at the pump.

breaking_news.headline: Microsoft is doing a hard reset of its Xbox gaming division
breaking_news.summary: This week, Microsoft announced they were laying off over 3,000 staff at Xbox. What will the impact be on the company? And what do these layoffs say about the gaming industry right now?

breaking_news.headline: Largest housing affordability bill in decades becomes law without Trump's signature
breaking_news.summary: President Trump refused to sign the bill without Congress first passing his sweeping voter ID bill.

breaking_news.headline: Justice Department subpoenas New York Times reporters over Air Force One reporting
breaking_news.summary: The Times says federal agents turned up on the doorsteps of several of its journalists to force grand jury testimony next week over their coverage of the Air Force One plane gifted to Trump by Qatar.

breaking_news.headline: What a Monopoly importer learned when it tried to make things in the U.S.A.
breaking_news.summary: After getting hit with tariffs for the imported board games he sells, Jonathan Silva decided to see if he could produce a version of his Monopoly game in the United States. This is what he learned.

breaking_news.headline: US Democrat Ro Khanna says he was detained by armed Israeli settlers
breaking_news.summary: Khanna, 49, was visiting the occupied West Bank when he was held for 90 minutes, he says.

breaking_news.headline: Trump administration subpoenas New York Times journalists over Air Force One reporting
breaking_news.summary: The reporters received the legal summons after they reported on alleged security issues with the president's new plane, which was gifted by Qatar.

breaking_news.headline: T. rex could become most expensive fossil ever - but it's a ​problem for scientists
breaking_news.summary: A 67 million-year-old Tyrannosaurus rex will go on sale in New York with a pre-sale value of $30m.

breaking_news.headline: At least two killed in Toronto street festival shooting
breaking_news.summary: Police say there was an exchange of gunfire between two individuals at the festival, and two firearms had been recovered from the scene.

breaking_news.headline: China evacuates nearly two million people as powerful typhoon makes landfall
breaking_news.summary: Schools, work and outdoor activities have been suspended in Zhejiang province and many transport services cancelled.

breaking_news.headline: Badly burned British couple rescued from ravine during Spain wildfires
breaking_news.summary: The unnamed pair were found semi-conscious with 40% burns after being trapped by the blazes raging through Almeria province.

breaking_news.headline: US Senator and close Trump ally Lindsey Graham dies after 'brief and sudden illness'
breaking_news.summary: The influential politician had just returned from Kyiv, where he met Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky on Friday.

breaking_news.headline: US launches fresh strikes as Iran closes Strait of Hormuz
breaking_news.summary: The strikes follow an attack on a Cyprus -flagged vessel travelling through the critical waterway.

breaking_news.headline: Vapes to have less enticing names and flavours to protect children
breaking_news.summary: People are being consulted about plans to stop vape companies using enticing flavour descriptions that "attract" children into experimenting.

breaking_news.headline: Man nearly sucked out of window mid-air on Ryanair plane, passengers say
breaking_news.summary: The man's wife held onto his legs for around five minutes to stop him from being sucked out, officials say.

breaking_news.headline: 'Cool in 90 seconds' - the fake portable air conditioners sweeping the internet
breaking_news.summary: The ASA says adverts claiming small devices can rapidly cool rooms were too good to be true.
